verdict.rationale: Multiple practice/location pages explicitly document M&A and IPO experience for venture-backed companies through exit: the UK page says the VC team advises 'from incubation through to exit,' France page cites 'cross border M&A and IPOs' for future unicorns, Germany page cites a top-10 global M&A ranking extending to startups, and Technology Transactions/IP Due Diligence pages describe sell-side M&A and M&A IP diligence work. This shows exit-stage (M&A and public offering) coverage is documented across the firm's own pages rather than being absent. Missing for 10: a single dedicated 'exit/IPO' practice page with concrete deal counts or league-table rankings specifically for IPOs, and independent corroboration of IPO/M&A outcomes beyond self-reported firm pages.
